definitions.explanation: Successfully meeting the required standards, especially in an examination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合格|ごうかく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{合格|ごうかく}⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧
{合格|ごうかく}⟦おめでとう→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧！

⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難関|なんかん}→難関：16164_nankan⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合格|ごうかく}⟦し→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んだ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: She passed the entrance exam for a prestigious university, and the whole family was overjoyed.

examples.english: All the hard work of studying late every day paid off, and I was able to pass the entrance exam for my school of choice.

notes:
{合格|ごうかく} means passing an exam or meeting a required standard. Most commonly associated with entrance exams in Japan's education system.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {合格|ごうかく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合格|ごうかく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pass an exam (uses に)
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合格|ごうかく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get into a university (uses に)

COMPOUNDS:
- {合格|ごうかく}⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: announcement of results
- {合格|ごうかく}⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: passing score/mark
- {合格|ごうかく}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: pass rate
- {合格|ごうかく}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: successful candidate
- {合格|ごうかく}⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: acceptance notice

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{不合格|ふごうかく}→不合格：05139_fugoukaku⟧ (failure, not passing). Also: ⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ is the colloquial verb for failing an exam.
